summary: On an iPhone a swipe over The Long Distance's sheet moved the page behind it, not the sheet, so its Book button was out of reach (every dish sheet: the page behind an open sheet scrolled).
fix: While a sheet is open the page behind can't scroll (html:has(dialog.sheet[open])), the sheet stops a swipe at its end (overscroll-behavior: contain), and the dish sheet's Book row is pinned to the sheet's bottom edge.
